The '''Feenix system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Feenix/Legends|Feenix]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Xaverri]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], during a visit to this system, ended up bilking the [[Unidentified Assistant Secretary to the D'Aelgoth Sector Moff|Assistant Secretary]] to the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] out of most of his life savings and and put him under suspicion of engaging in [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref><ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref>
